evidence: Keyboard-only pass: Tab through the primary navigation and verify whether every link receives focus and can be activated with Enter. Attach screenshot as screenshots/01-focus.png.
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to reach or activate important services if a navigation control cannot be focused or operated without a mouse.
recommended_fix: Use native <a> elements for navigation, preserve a logical tab order, and provide a clearly visible :focus-visible indicator.

evidence: Inspect every input, select and textarea and confirm that each has a visible, programmatically associated label. Attach screenshot as screenshots/02-form-label.png.
user_impact: Screen-reader users and users with cognitive or learning disabilities may not know what information a form control requires.
recommended_fix: Associate every visible <label> with its control using matching for/id attributes and provide concise instructions for required formats.

evidence: Inspect the heading tree and confirm that headings follow a logical hierarchy from the page-level H1 through H2/H3 sections. Record the actual heading tree in screenshots/03-headings.png.
user_impact: Screen-reader users who navigate by headings may have difficulty understanding the structure or locating sections when heading levels are inconsistent.
recommended_fix: Use one meaningful H1 and follow the content hierarchy with H2/H3 headings; do not choose heading levels only for visual size.

evidence: Inspect header, navigation, main and footer landmarks. If repeated navigation landmarks exist, verify that their accessible names distinguish them. Capture the accessibility-tree evidence as screenshots/04-landmarks.png.
user_impact: Assistive-technology users may have difficulty quickly identifying and jumping between major page regions.
recommended_fix: Prefer semantic HTML landmarks and add aria-label or aria-labelledby only where multiple landmarks need disambiguation.

evidence: Submit the form and trigger both success and validation-error states. Verify that status information is exposed without requiring focus to move. Attach screenshot as screenshots/05-status.png.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not learn that a submission succeeded or failed if the message is visually displayed but not programmatically announced.
recommended_fix: Use role=status for non-critical updates and role=alert for urgent errors, with concise messages and stable live-region behavior.
